run_llm2vec_embedding_extraction: run the script to extract text embeddings from CSV test datasets using an LLM2Vec model
extract_embeddings_for_subjects: extract embeddings for all test subjects in a dataset directory and save as numpy arrays
format_example_for_prompting: format a DataFrame row into a multiple-choice prompt string with optional answer inclusion
encode_text_with_llm2vec: encode a list of prompt strings into vector embeddings using the LLM2Vec encoder
load_llm2vec_model: load a pretrained LLM2Vec model with PEFT adapters and configure mean pooling for encoding
